message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fluent-bit && git log --all --oneline -S "val_len >= 4" -- src/flb_parser.c | head` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
I found the fix. In the current master, the BOOL case checks `val_len >= 4` and `val_len >= 5` before calling `strncasecmp`. This confirms the vulnerability: in the vulnerable version, `strncasecmp(val, "true", 4)` and `strncasecmp(val, "false", 5)` are called without checking `val_len`, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ when the value is shorter than 4/5 bytes and located at the end of the input buffer.

Let me find the exact fix commit for this.
